constraints.name: finance_summaries_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_finance_summaries_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_finance
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_finance BEFORE UPDATE ON finance_summaries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_finance_summaries
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_finance_summaries BEFORE UPDATE ON finance_summaries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: finance_summaries_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_summaries_pkey ON public.finance_summaries USING btree (order_id)

indexes.name: idx_finance_summaries_company
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_finance_summaries_company ON public.finance_summaries USING btree (company_id)
